text: An anniversary is a day when you remember something special from the past. It comes back every year. Pokémon is 30 years old this year.
To debut means to show something to people for the first time. Pokémon debuted in Japan.
Fantastical means so strange and magical that it could not be real, like a dragon.
Pokémon is a game about magical creatures. It also has cards, apps, and a TV show.
Pikachu is a yellow Pokémon creature. It is one of the most famous ones.
Japan is a country in Asia. It is an island country, far across the Pacific Ocean from America.
A goal is what you are trying to do. The goal of the game is to catch and train creatures.
Creatures are living things, like animals. In stories, they can be magical.
Fans are people who love something very much, like a game or a team.
Apps are little programs on a phone or tablet. You can play games on them.
In-person means you go there and meet people face to face, not on a screen.
In a trading card game, players collect cards, swap them with friends, and use them to play.
TCG stands for Trading Card Game.
Evolving means slowly changing and growing into something new.
A celebration is a happy event to mark something special, like a party.
To organize an event means to plan it and get it ready.
To launch something means to start it or put it out for people to use.
Products are things that a company makes and sells, like toys and cards.
A vice president is a boss who helps lead a company or group.
A community is a group of people who share something, like fans of a game.
A brand is a company's name and the things it makes. Here, Pokémon is the brand.
To keep moving forward means to keep growing and making new things, not to stop.
This is the kind of Spanish spoken in Mexico, South America, and nearby places.
Available means you can get it or use it.
Languages are the ways people talk and write, like English, Spanish, and Japanese.
To gather means to come together in one place.
San Francisco is a big city in California, by the Pacific Ocean.
California is a state on the west coast of the United States.
The World Championships is a big contest. The best players from around the world play to see who wins.
A reporter learns about events and writes about them. A TFK Kid Reporter is a kid who does this.
On the scene means being right there where something is happening.
A first-person account is a story told by the person who was there, using the word I.
Malaysia is a country in Southeast Asia, far from California.
A youth player is a young person who plays a game or sport.
To emphasize means to say that something is very important.
An attendee is a person who goes to an event.
A person's background is where they come from and what their life has been like.
